claims.statement: A diff takes a Source (DB or Model) and a Target (DB or Snapshot); the result upgrades the target to the source.
claims.supports: Source options: DB or Model. Target options: DB or Snapshot. source minus target

claims.statement: A persistence unit must be selected for a model source; multiple data stores need separate runs per unit.
claims.supports: A persistence unit must be selected ... separate runs per persistence unit

claims.statement: A Liquibase diff changelog compares Source (DB or Model) with Target (DB or Snapshot) and goes through a preview before saving.
claims.supports: Diff Database Changelog dialog: Source DB or Model; Target DB or Snapshot ... preview
